text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle*, *BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! The chance of a lifetime has 
arrived! Am I dreaming?! Is this a dream?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Before the Takarazuka Kinen, it's 
my chance for revenge against 
Suzuka-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
Fans are welcomed to Tracen Academy for 
various events and festivities.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The main highlight among them is the 
'Sports Competitions.' You can see 
Umamusume active in events they don't 
usually do, like ball games and martial 
arts."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In a race, she's still got the upper hand! 
But if it's another sport...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Silence Suzuka! Crushing the 
competition even in racewalking! Just 
briskly striding along in total silence!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was just walking along completely lost 
in thought... Was this really the right 
choice, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka dominates in volleyball 
too! Superhuman—no, super-Umamusume 
leaping power!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was just running and jumping, all I did 
was match the toss she set up so well for 
me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!? Even outside of races, her 
individual skills reveal unmatched 
potential!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“YES, that's right! Like in a three-legged 
race, for instance!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka dominates in the 
three-legged race too! A golden duo with 
Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You did it, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Que? Spe-chan, why are you betraying 
us?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, no matter what, by any means 
necessary! El must defeat Suzuka-senpai to 
build momentum, desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, El will sell her soul to the 
devil... to Diablo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai, let's settle this fair and 
square! With 'pro-wrestling'!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, that's El-chan's specialty!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is pro wrestling even an event? I 
remember sumo being one, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then sumo is totally OK too, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go, Suzuka-senpai! Let's 
sumo and enjoy ourselves together!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-Um, wait a second...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka was dragged along forcibly. 
And so the sumo match began, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after the start, El Condor Pasa was 
blown clear out of the ring.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-What power... Plowing straight down the 
tracks without a single turn, she's simply 
unstoppable...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's Silence Suzuka for you! A runaway 
train if there ever was one!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Let's go, El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who looks like they 
can win!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, these cheers, these expectations... 
how could I ever fail to answer them?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"No, no way! Suzuka-senpai, one more 
match! Hyaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (ZWOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No way, not yet—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bolstered by the cheers of the fans in the 
crowd, El Condor Pasa bravely got back to 
her feet time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With each time she stood back up, her 
intensity was visibly surging.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Can you... still stand?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is telling me to win... DEES! 
This is the final—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: TEYAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bishooom!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, El Condor Pasa couldn't manage 
a single win.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And now for the MVP interview. Silence 
Suzuka-san, care to share a few words?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm exhausted. So very exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Fighting Spirit Award 
winner, El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is, El-El is, El-El-El is... SOOOOO 
FRUSTRATED, DEEEES!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Heeeey, Suzuka! Team El-El is definitely 
gonna crush your crew!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of sheer frustration, her tone of 
voice had started sounding like a heel 
wrestler's.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will, for everyone's cheers... live up, 
live uuuuup to theeeem!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah, YOU'LL REGRET THIIIIIS 
DESU!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Warm applause and laughter simultaneously 
erupt from the venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was defeated, El Condor Pasa's 
unbelievable, valiant effort had captured 
the hearts of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me, judges. Shouldn't the MVP 
go to El-san...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think the one who hyped up the 
Thanksgiving Festival the most... was 
El-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A relaxed, nonchalant comment. This Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival was a stark reminder 
of Silence Suzuka's terrifying physical 
prowess."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The tips of my feet are... turned 
outward...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did I do it? I did it...! I finally did 
it, YESSSS-DEATH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa gives it her absolute all 
to snatch a win. The venue erupts in an 
uproar.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And now for the MVP interview. Silence 
Suzuka-san, care to share a few words?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The MVP is... not me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Please ask El-san. She's the one who hyped 
things up the most, after all.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now then, El Condor Pasa-san.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, thank you, everyone! Thank you, 
thank you so, so muuuuch, YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your passionate cheering, I was 
able to land a blow on Suzuka-senpai, 
yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous cheers envelope El Condor Pasa. 
And naturally, beyond this, the fans 
already have their eyes on that race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai, let's make this a great 
Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that Mainichi Okan, El has been 
aiming for a rematch with Suzuka-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You are my Dragon Gate! The gate I must 
leap through! Please race the 
newly-strengthened me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In a real race, it won't go like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things won, and things out of reach. Even 
so, El Condor Pasa's feelings reached 
Silence Suzuka loud and clear.
